workflow.updateError: Unable to update job workflow options
workflow.runTimeoutDescription: The maximum length of time (in minutes) that a single job run is allowed to span before it times out. 0 means no overall timeout.
workflow.runTimeoutTables: A table has no limit of its own: it is stopped when it no longer makes progress. At this limit, the run stops the tables still being copied and puts the destination triggers back.
workflow.engineDescription: Transformation engine used to run this job. Default follows the deployment setting.
workflow.consistencyScopeDescription: Deterministic consistency (Athanor engine only): the same source value gets the same anonymized value everywhere in this scope. Beyond a single run, outputs stay linkable over time.

form.name: Name
form.nameDescription: Name of the hook for display and reference, must be unique
form.priorityDescription: Determines execution order. Lower values are higher priority
form.enabledDescription: Whether or not this hook will be invoked during a job run
form.hookTypeDescription: The type of hook. Currently only SQL hooks are supported
form.queryDescription: The SQL query that will be invoked
form.timingDescription: The lifecycle of when the hook will run
form.preSync: Pre Sync - Before first table sync, truncation, schema init
form.postSync: Post Sync - After the last table sync
form.connectionDescription: The connection that this hook will be invoked against

validation.sqlOnly: Only SQL hooks are currently supported
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 3 characters
validation.nameMax: The Hook name must be at most 100 characters
validation.nameFormat: Name must be between 3-100 characters and may only include lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
validation.sqlConfigRequired: SQL config is required when hook type is sql

review.title: Changes to review
review.description: What this job's runs changed in its mappings as its source evolved. Open a change to keep what the run chose or pick another transformer; select several to confirm them at once.
review.nothing: Nothing waiting: every change the runs made has been reviewed.
review.reviewed: {count, plural, one {# change reviewed} other {# changes reviewed}}
review.reviewError: Unable to mark these changes reviewed
review.selected: {count, plural, one {# change selected} other {# changes selected}}

panel.pickFirst: Pick another transformer or option first
panel.changed: Changed from what the run chose.
